name: How long does it take to install energy-efficient windows?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install energy-efficient windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of energy-efficient window installation depends on the number of windows, their size, and the complexity of the installation. A typical full-home replacement can take anywhere from a few days to a week. For homes in our service area, we prioritize efficient scheduling and clear communication throughout the process to minimize disruption, especially for busy families in high-density areas like Oakland or downtown San Rafael.
